title: How ChatGPT learns about the world while protecting privacy
summary: Learn how ChatGPT safeguards your privacy, reduces personal data in training, and gives you control over whether your conversations improve AI models.
body: Learn how ChatGPT safeguards your privacy, reduces personal data in training, and gives you control over whether your conversations improve AI models.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了关于ChatGPT如何处理用户隐私的说明，重点介绍了在模型训练过程中减少个人数据使用的方法，并赋予用户对对话数据是否用于模型改进的控制权。
